values.binNote: Wiki lists a flat 50% refund of that rank's cost (40-60); bin's ManaRefundFail=0.5 is the fraction, matching the wiki's 'half the mana cost' description.

values.meaning: recast lockout delay before the beam fires
values.binNote: No matching bin data value found for the 0.5s recast delay; castTime=0.005 in bin is negligible and does not represent this delay.

mechanics.claim: Arcanopulse can be recast within the duration and will cancel automatically afterwards, refunding half the mana cost.
mechanics.quote: ''Arcanopulse'' can be recast within the duration and will cancel automatically afterwards, refunding half the {{sti|mana|{{as|mana cost}}}}.

mechanics.claim: The recast fires a beam in a line after a brief unable-to-act delay, dealing magic damage to enemies hit.
mechanics.quote: '''Xerath'''  fires a beam of energy in a line in the target direction that deals {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit.

mechanics.claim: If the charge is interrupted or completes without reactivation, it is cancelled and refunds half the mana cost (no damage dealt).
mechanics.quote: If the charge is {{tip|interrupt|interrupted}} or completes without reactivation, ''Arcanopulse'' is cancelled and refunds {{sti|mana|{{as|half the mana cost}}}}.

mechanics.claim: The ability's cooldown starts after the effect completes, not on initial cast.
Arcanopulse will not fire and deal damage if Xerath dies during the 0.5 second recast delay.
mechanics.quote: ''Arcanopulse'' will not fire and deal damage if '''Xerath''' dies during the {{rutngt|0.5}} recast delay.
